releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.6 is a UX + workflow release. Deep Field opens on Stem Field, the Genre EQ Guide is readable and adds a whole-genre overview plus an in-view genre picker. Auto-Mix rows collapse so every stem fits without scrolling, the peak-ceiling preset has a clear RED active state, and a new one-click TRUE Auto-Mix applies the recommendations to each Link sender's built-in Trim (reversible; it adjusts AURA's own Trim, never a DAW fader). The spectrum legend moved to a top strip so it no longer collides with the curve. Settings now supports multiple AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Together, Ollama, LM Studio, or a Custom endpoint) with model, endpoint, API key and Test Connection; keys are stored on this machine only. Fully close the DAW before installing.
